name: contextforge
description: Local-first, task-aware context compiler for coding agents

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-parser-assets.mjs dist/adapters/parser/assets
scripts.build:test: node scripts/clean.mjs .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/copy-parser-assets.mjs .test-dist/src/adapters/parser/assets
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:test
